mainText: Die wichtigsten KI-Meldungen: Workslop. Wenn KI Vertrauen kostet. | Schere. Stein. KI.. KI spart Arbeit – und macht sie anderen? (The Decoder.) OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’. Data centers are deeply unpopular. (TechCrunch AI.) Ölkonzern Saudi Aramco kauft sich für den KI-Ausbau groß bei Humain ein. Aus der Tech-Welt: heise+ | Malware-Lage 2026: Weniger Lösegeld, mehr Lücken, neue Tricks. Ransomware-Gangs jagen große Fische, Fake-Captchas schleusen Infostealer ein, KI spürt Lücken auf. (heise online.) Ford launches a ‘privacy promise’ and explains how and why it uses customer data. Ford said it's making an "explicit commitment" to its customers that "their vehicle data is safe" with the company. (TechCrunch.) Kühlschränke in Lebensmittelläden weiterer Länder geknackt. Vor Kurzem gab es Angriffe auf Kühlschränke französischer Supermärkte. (heise online.) Borrowed reading: stories from our extended colleagues. Five stories worth your time from our extended colleagues at CIO, Computerworld, Macworld, and PCWorld. (TechCrunch.)

Neues aus der Szene: Juan Atkins, Detroit techno pioneer, has died. The visionary artist who helped shape the sound of Motor City was reportedly found unresponsive in a hotel room in Mexico City on Saturday (31st) (DJ Mag.) Man arrested following stabbing at London nightclub Studio 338. The incident occurred during a Halloween event on Friday night (Mixmag.) Cevin Fisher, celebrated New Jersey house DJ and producer, dies aged 63. A fixture of the US house scene for four decades, Fisher was behind anthems including ‘The Freaks Come Out’ and ‘(You Got Me) Burnin’ Up’ (DJ Mag.) Techno originator Juan Atkins has died aged 64. The Detroit pioneer was discovered unresponsive in a hotel room ahead of a performance in Mexico City, his management has confirmed (Mixmag.)
